method: Consecutive starting seeds, current local HOMESTEAD_RULES, no commands, gifts, immigration or magic unlock. Current stepDay is called directly; no observer-instrumented source. Changes tested together: accessible food accounting and experienced food planning, anticipatory physical housing, and paid neighboring-community visits/families. The archived ten seeds are compared separately. This combined comparison does not isolate each change causally. Endings are observations at the horizon, not guarantees of permanent survival.
